prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark brown hair wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white loose-fitting pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P05","P08"],"uncertain":["P06"],"reason":"P01, P02, P03, P05, and P08 all show long dark brown hair and are wearing white long-sleeve crop tops with white loose-fitting pants. P06 has long hair that appears dark brown in some views but is partially obscured or has lighter highlights; the top is white and long-sleeved, and pants are white and loose, so the hair color is uncertain. P04 has blonde hair, P07 wears shorts, so they are clear non-matches."}

parsed.reason: P01, P02, P03, P05, and P08 all show long dark brown hair and are wearing white long-sleeve crop tops with white loose-fitting pants.
